verdict.title: The AI trade is dividing by funding quality—not yet a general credit panic.
verdict.summary: Nasdaq weakness contrasted with 29 Oct broad equity participation, falling 2Y/10Y Treasury yields and previously tight high-yield OAS. High inflation still constrains the Fed; falling yields are an observed market response, not proof of easy policy. Reduce concentration uncertainty in existing holdings before allocating new risk.
verdict.condition: Review only. Check current broker cash, warrant terms, dated securities quotes, issuer cash conversion and MYR FX before trading.

marketObservations.label: US equity rotation
marketObservations.observation: 29 Oct Nasdaq −1.37%; Russell 2000 +1.0%; monitored S&P breadth 406 advances / 97 declines; RSP about +1.20% vs SPY about −0.38%.
marketObservations.implication: Mega-cap AI valuation reset ≠ proved market-wide liquidation; assess sustained equal-weight strength.
marketObservations.test: 30 Oct close breadth and RSP/SPY 3–5 sessions; same-vintage credit spread.

marketObservations.label: Treasury repricing
marketObservations.observation: 29 Oct US indicative 10Y yield 4.98% from 5.05% on 28 Oct; 2Y 4.61% from 4.67%; real 10Y 2.63% from 2.67% in dated secondary series.
marketObservations.asOf: 29 Oct completed US close, Asia follow-through not a matched settlement
marketObservations.implication: Duration benefited as risk appetite weakened, despite inflation. Corporate AI financing rates do not equal Treasury yields.
marketObservations.test: Next official real/nominal curve, auctions, IG/HY spreads; no automatic VGIT/TLT order.

marketObservations.label: Fed inflation constraint
marketObservations.observation: September headline PCE 3.6% YoY / 0.5% MoM; core PCE 3.1% YoY / 0.3% MoM; real spending essentially flat.
marketObservations.implication: Inflation remains above target while real consumption stalls; PCE matched forecasts, not a surprise beat.

source.label: US BEA Personal Income and Outlays, Sep 2026

marketObservations.test: Next core services, labor, Fed path; avoid assuming inflation automatically lifts DXY.

marketObservations.label: Japan carry/yen
marketObservations.observation: BoJ held 1.25% by 8–1 on 30 Oct; raised FY27 inflation outlook, accelerated planned ETF disposals effective Jan 2027. Reuters USD/JPY ~157.115 observed Asia session.
marketObservations.asOf: 30 Oct Asia session before Ueda press conference
marketObservations.implication: Yen strength/overseas risk financing are watch factors; no confirmed carry unwind or closed 4H break.
marketObservations.test: Closed USDJPY/DXY 4H + daily bands, JGB yields, post-Ueda reaction.

marketObservations.label: Oil, ships and inflation
marketObservations.observation: 30 Oct 03:23 UTC Reuters quoted expiring December Brent $116.08 and January Brent $112.19; UKMTO #186 original attack description and secondary reporting differ on weapon. No measured cargo loss.
marketObservations.asOf: 30 Oct 03:23 UTC Reuters intraday, distinct futures months
marketObservations.implication: Energy and freight premiums matter for XOM/MISC/HIBISCS and inflation; don't compare different expiry contracts as a daily oil move.
marketObservations.test: Obtain UKMTO numbered PDF, same-month Brent/WTI settlements, EIA inventory, cargo and freight evidence.

marketObservations.label: Custody / crypto contagion
marketObservations.observation: Binance disclosed estimated $6.3bn gross impact; earlier ~$3bn frozen assets are not net recovered proceeds. BTC near $77.4k in dated intraday readings.
marketObservations.implication: BTC/COIN/MSTR and crypto allocation carry custody/liquidity headline risk. Do not assert final losses or Binance insolvency.

source.label: Bluebelly public reported editorial and issuer disclosure

marketObservations.test: Official post-mortem, proof of reserves, withdrawals restoration and dated BTC market control.

newsroom.evidence: INTC guidance disappointed; AMZN reported AWS +39.3% but TTM FCF −$42.357bn; SNDK strong data-centre results met high expectations and broad risk-off.
newsroom.investorMeaning: Separate expectations, future guidance, capex/FCF and pre- vs after-results price reactions.

newsroom.title: Bluebelly officially sourced earnings
newsroom.evidence: AMZN Q3 CFO $42.422bn less net PPE $75.878bn = −$33.456bn issuer-definition quarterly FCF; trailing FCF −$42.357bn. INTC Q4 revenue guide $15–16bn.
newsroom.investorMeaning: Amazon's profitable cloud growth does not erase funding/cash-consumption risk; Intel's quarter does not settle the weaker forward outlook.

newsroom.title: BoJ hawkish hold; ETF-sales pace to rise
newsroom.evidence: 1.25% hold, 8–1 vote and January 2027 planned ETF-sale acceleration; contemporaneous Japanese share declines also reflect US AI losses.
newsroom.investorMeaning: Update yen/carry risk questions without asserting a verified unwind or assigning every Nikkei move to BoJ.

newsroom.title: Binance incident affects crypto risk
newsroom.evidence: Issuer estimated impact $6.3bn; frozen assets and net loss unconfirmed.
newsroom.investorMeaning: Do not promote crypto as a defensive alternative while custody/market impacts unresolved.

watchlistLanes.title: AI earnings: demand versus funding
watchlistLanes.thesis: Supplier growth can persist while the biggest buyers face a negative FCF cycle. Do not assume all chips reprice alike.
watchlistLanes.required: Current price/valuation; management cash commitments and debt; order conversion, customer funding, HBM or interconnect margin, free cash flow.
watchlistLanes.risk: Capex repricing, financing credit, supplier multiple compression.

watchlistLanes.title: Power/grid picks-and-shovels
watchlistLanes.thesis: Grid equipment and contracted utility demand may prove more durable than pure AI capacity speculation, not valuation immune.
watchlistLanes.required: Signed backlog, customer cash guarantees, financing, actual margins/FCF, Malaysia tariff regulation and next quote.
watchlistLanes.risk: Overextended valuations and project timing; no automatic Malaysia beneficiary assumption.

watchlistLanes.title: Treasury / quality versus funding stress
watchlistLanes.thesis: Recent Treasury rally supports duration on the tape, but hot PCE, real yields, FX and inflation shocks can reverse it.
watchlistLanes.required: MYR fees/FX, dated 2–30Y nominal and real Treasury curve, high yield OAS, issuer cash if equity.
watchlistLanes.risk: Duration loss, currency, opportunity cost; cash is not automatically available.

watchlistLanes.title: Oil, LNG, refiners and fertiliser
watchlistLanes.thesis: Hormuz, refined-product cracks and LNG transmission differ; don't invest from an unverified shipping count.
watchlistLanes.required: Same-contract crude settles, cargo/flow data, refined-product margins, issuer FCF and freight/insurance.
watchlistLanes.risk: Conflict de-escalation, reversal of margins, commodity volatility.

watchlistLanes.title: Bursa / China: AI orders versus margins
watchlistLanes.thesis: China memory/optical AI and Malaysia grid themes are not automatically cheap in a global tech drawdown.
watchlistLanes.required: Current local exchange quotes, issuer filings, FX and regulator constraints, orders, pricing and cash conversion.
watchlistLanes.risk: Old HK/MY reference prices; liquidity and policy risk; GRAB credit acquisition.

watchlistLanes.title: Crypto exposure and market plumbing
watchlistLanes.thesis: Exchange incident is issuer-reported; do not infer settled losses or structural insolvency.
watchlistLanes.required: Issuer technical post-mortem, proof of reserves, exchange functionality and matched timestamps.
watchlistLanes.risk: Custody, volatility and crypto-linked equity leverage.
